video.title: 2nd Place Lemons Finish | Fast Lap in Our Honda CR-V (Sonoma Raceway)
video.camera: hood / windscreen GoPro, about 1.3 m above the road
video.stepped: every 2.0 s from 0:00 to 2:24 (73 frames), apexes refined at 0.5 s

anchors.name: S/F
anchors.how: chequered line passing under the hood at 0:01.2: frames captured at 0.05 s precision in Chrome (round 5): at 0:00.9 the line is ~10 m ahead, at 0:01.15 it is at the hood's front edge, as in the 2:18.0 frame one lap later; was 0:02.2 (from '0:00 = 2:16'), which made the S/F-to-footbridge stretch 45 m/s

anchors.name: footbridge
anchors.how: the T2 footbridge (track.json / scenery bridge s 295.3) passes overhead between 0:08.5 and 0:09.0 (0.5 s steps); 0:09.0 (round 5): the 0:08 frame shows the paddock-side Jersey end ~5 m away and the bridge deck ~30-40 m ahead (deck 4.2 m above the camera, 50 px above the horizon), so the passage is at the end of the bracket

anchors.name: T5
anchors.how: right-hander at the foot of the bank wall, between 0:40 and 0:42 (0:40 gave 38 m/s out of T4: too fast)

anchors.name: T6
anchors.how: Carousel apex kerb (left) ahead at 0:54, alongside 0:55-0:56

anchors.name: T7
anchors.how: turn-in past the T7 station (0:72), island kerb right

anchors.name: T7a
anchors.how: 7a island nose with the delineator (1:16); 1:15.5 gave 39 m/s between the two hairpins

anchors.name: T8
anchors.how: T8 apex kerb (left) alongside at 1:20, turn-in just before

anchors.name: T11
anchors.how: hairpin apex kerb (right) alongside, 0.5 s steps 2:00.5-2:03.5

anchors.name: T12
anchors.how: end of the pit-road wall (manifest 3705-3964) just ahead at 2:12 (2:09.5 gave 18 m/s on the front straight)

anchors.name: S/F lap 2
anchors.how: chequered line under the hood, 0.5 s steps 2:16.5-2:18

dropped_anchors.name: T1
dropped_anchors.how: turn-in left about 7 m before the pit-wall nose (s ~103), passed between the 0:04 and 0:06 frames
dropped_anchors.why: T1 is a flat kink with no apex marker; at 0:05.0 it implied 54 m/s from T1 to the footbridge (passage timed to 0.5 s at 0:08.7), so the footbridge replaces it

corrections.why: the 0:02.2 anchor assumed 0:00 shows the place of 2:16. Captured at 0.05 s steps (round 5): the line is ~10 m ahead at 0:00.9 and at the hood's front edge at 0:01.15, as in the 2:18.0 frame; the line passes under the camera at ~0:01.2. With 0:02.2 the car averaged 45 m/s to the footbridge (295.3 m; on c20_s1980 the span crosses the left edge at s 290-295)

within the timed bracket 0:08.5-0:09.0: the 0:08 frame puts the deck 30-40 m ahead, about 1 s at the 33 m/s the S/F fix gives; with 8.7 the 0:08 rows mapped 2 m short of the bridge; confirmed in Chrome: at 0:09.0 the deck is directly overhead
